rows.en:
(Still, I was really surprised to hear Ranka
got scouted by a talent agency.)

\p-kun!
What are you spacing out for?!
Huh? What's up, Nanase?

There's so much we need to do
to support Ranka-san!
N-Nanase... calm down a little.

Why are you being so laid-back?!
Beat the Galactic Fairy!!
rows.notes: 'Datou! Ginga no Yousei' as a rallying slogan; repeated in quotes in c18877/c18884.

rows.en:
"Beat the Galactic Fairy!!"...
That's a pretty big goal...

It'll be a cakewalk for Ranka-san!
There's absolutely no doubt about it!!
(A cakewalk...?)
Come on, let's get ready, \p-kun!
(I guess I don't get any say in this...)

(Still, I was really surprised to hear Ranka-chan
got scouted by a talent agency.)

\p-san!
What are you spacing out for?!

"Beat the Galactic Fairy!!"...
That's a pretty big goal...
Come on, let's get ready, \p-san!
(I don't get any say in this, do I...)
(Now then, maybe I'll eat at Nyan-Nyan today.)

Welcome~
Oh? If it isn't \p-kun.

Oh, Nanase, so you're working today.
Thanks for all your hard work.
What would you like to order?
Let's see... Then I'll have the Galaxy Ramen.

Certainly.
Please wait just a moment.

(Still, Nanase really looks great
in that Nyan-Nyan China dress.)

(I bet some customers come to the shop
just to see Nanase...)
Here you go, one Galaxy Ramen.

Um, you've been looking at me for a while now.
Is there something else you'd like to order?
N-No, it's nothing...
(Oops, I guess I stared a bit too much.)
(Now then, maybe I'll eat at Nyan-Nyan today.)

Welcome~
Oh? If it isn't \p-san.
Let's see... Then I'll have the Galaxy Ramen.

(Still, Nanase really looks great
in that Nyan-Nyan China dress.)

(I bet some customers come to the shop
just to see Nanase...)
N-No, it's nothing...
(Oops, I guess I stared a bit too much.)

(Now, lunchtime... What should I eat...
Oh, it's Luca and Nanase... Are they arguing...?)
Oh, come on, Luca-kun, why don't you get it?

With all due respect, Nanase-san,
this is the one thing I won't give up on,
not even for you!
I never thought you'd be this stubborn, Luca-kun!

Now, now, you two...
What's going on?

Oh, \p-san,
listen to this!
rows.notes: Luca uses -san for the player in both versions.

rows.en: Yeah, what?

We were talking about lunch, and since it's hot,
I told Nanase-san, "Lunch today has to be
Chilled Galaxy Noodles!" But...
rows.notes: Hiyashi Galaxy chuka (chilled ramen noodles), not in the glossary.

rows.en:
And I think a hot day like this is exactly when
you want a "Super-Spicy Maguro Chili-Chili Bowl"...
rows.notes: Gekikara maguro chiri-chiri don, not in the glossary; follows maguro bun / Super Chili-Chili Dog.

rows.en: ...and we got into a bit of an argument...

Well, you can get both at Nyan-Nyan, so why not
just go together instead of fighting?

Hmm...
That's true! Well then, Luca-kun, shall we go?

Yes!
Let's go, Nanase-san!
(Those two must really get along...)

(Now, lunchtime... What should I eat...
Oh, it's Luca-kun and Nanase... Are they arguing...?)

Hey, hey, you two...
What in the world is going on?
(Those two must really get along...)

(I think I'll go have a nice, relaxing tea
at Silver Moon.)

(I think I'll go have a nice, relaxing tea
at Silver Moon.)
(Today I'll eat something tasty at Nyan-Nyan.)
(Today I'll eat something tasty at Nyan-Nyan.)

(Maybe I'll look for something unusual
at Folmo today.)

(Today I'm gonna look for something unusual
at Folmo.)
(All right, today I'm going shopping at 199.)
rows.notes: No quotes around 199 here: the Japanese has none (earlier lines with kagi brackets used quotes).

rows.en: (All right, today I'm going shopping at 199.)

uncertain: c18876/c18877/c18884: datou ('defeat!') slogan rendered 'Beat the Galactic Fairy!!'.
